description: Source code for EGL object management in Android, including classes for EGL objects, surfaces, and contexts, with functions for handling metadata, resource management, and extension caching.

classes.name: egl_object_t
classes.description: Base class for EGL objects, managing reference counting and lifecycle.

classes.name: egl_surface_t
classes.description: Represents an EGL rendering surface, manages metadata, connection state, and native window interactions.

classes.name: egl_context_t
classes.description: Represents an EGL rendering context, manages extension strings and context sharing.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Marks the object as terminated and removes it from display management.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes the object if reference count reaches zero.

methods.name: setSmpte2086Attribute
methods.description: Sets SMPTE 2086 metadata attributes for the surface.

methods.name: setCta8613Attribute
methods.description: Sets CTA861.3 metadata attributes for the surface.

methods.name: getSmpte2086Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves SMPTE 2086 metadata if dirty and complete.

methods.name: getCta8613Metadata
methods.description: Retrieves CTA861.3 metadata if dirty and complete.

methods.name: getColorSpaceAttribute
methods.description: Gets the color space attribute of the surface.

methods.name: onMakeCurrent
methods.description: Caches extension strings and manages GL extension handling when context is made current.
